name: Alice-tachi no Gogo Vol. 2
original_name: アリスたちの午後 Vol.2
source:
As the name implies, this is the continuation of Alice-tachi no Gogo Vol. 1. The two volumes were released as separate game packages, but they can be considered two parts of the same game.

The second volume has exactly the same story as the first: as a journalist working for a company named "Oh!", the player has to explore a huge Expo area and take pictures of as many pretty girls as possible, preferably undressed. 

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/alice-tachi-no-gogo-vol-2]mobygames[/url]]
